About Avoca

Avoca is a Y Combinator–backed vertical AI company transforming how home services businesses convert demand into revenue. Home services is a $500B+ industry, and more than 95% of revenue still flows through call centers—where missed calls, slow follow-up, and operational chaos cause massive leakage. Avoca fixes this.

  • Leveling up teams with coaching tools and analytics

The result: 15–40% more booked jobs in the first 30 days, protected ad spend, and dramatically simplified operations.

We move 2–3× faster than any competitor, ship new products constantly, and work hand-in-hand with the largest HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and home service brands in the country.

We’re hiring Product Engineers—generalist full-stack builders who thrive at the intersection of engineering, product, and real-world operational impact.

You’ll ship features end-to-end across a fast-expanding platform (inbound voice AI, outbound engines, dispatch, speed-to-lead, coaching), working directly with founders and forward-deployed engineers to solve high-stakes problems for customers.

This is a high-ownership, high-velocity environment where what you build is used immediately by thousands of technicians, CSRs, and operators—and directly drives revenue for our customers.

  • Own features end-to-end — design, build, launch, measure, iterate

  • Build real-time AI-driven user experiences, backend services, and data workflows

  • Turn customer feedback into product improvements through rapid iteration

  • Work closely with Product, Customer Success, FDEs, and GTM teams

  • Hold a high bar for testing, reliability, and operational excellence

  • Navigate ambiguous requirements and ruthlessly prioritize impact

  • Contribute to a fast-moving engineering culture with massive surface area to own

  • Category-defining vertical AI company in a massive underserved market

  • 10× ARR growth year-over-year and expanding rapidly across mid-market and enterprise

  • Work directly with technical founders from the MIT Voice AI Lab

  • Ship 2–3× faster than competitors—engineers take features from idea → production in weeks

  • Real ownership: the work you do directly impacts revenue for thousands of businesses

  • Join at the moment when core product, customer, and GTM systems are being built

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery builds the training data and evaluation infrastructure that frontier AI labs use to improve their models. They work with all five of the world's leading AI labs to design high-signal datasets and run rigorous evaluations that go beyond static benchmarks. One of the fastest-growing companies in their YC batch, backed by Y Combinator, BoxGroup, Lightspeed, Warburg Pincus, Silver Lake, and Index Ventures, with $30M raised at a $300M valuation.

About the Role

This is a founding-level role sitting directly at the intersection of technical execution and strategic leadership. You'll own high-impact initiatives end-to-end, from requirements through delivery, managing teams of software engineers, data scientists, and ML specialists while shipping production code yourself. One week you're scoping a dataset pipeline for a frontier lab; the next you're debugging infrastructure under live pressure or designing quality control systems that power $10M+ contracts. You'll work directly with the founding team and interface with research leads at Anthropic, OpenAI, and the other labs shaping the frontier. Success means compressing cycle time, building systems that scale to multiple labs simultaneously, and becoming the person the founders trust with their highest-priority, most ambiguous problems.

  • Interface directly with research teams at leading AI labs to understand their needs, translate them into technical specs, and ensure delivery meets their standards.

Must-Have

  • Own and elevate the Known mobile app end-to-end in React Native across iOS and Android

  • Take products from concept to production with a high degree of autonomy and ownership

  • Steward the quality and craft of a consumer product that is held to Apple-level design standards

Must-Have

Technical

  • 2 to 6 years of production React Native experience. This is the single most important requirement

  • Experience with complex audio or voice features in a mobile context is a strong differentiator

  • Full-stack capability to take features end-to-end when needed

  • Has worked at a company where React Native was the primary mobile framework, such as Discord, early Airbnb, early Instacart, or equivalent

Someone who:

  • Has the rare combination of strong React Native fundamentals and consumer product instincts

The product helps banks and fintechs eliminate 90% of manual work, cut compliance costs by 4x, and make onboarding instantaneous. The team has won every single deal they have competed for, including seven-figure contracts with leading banks.

About the Role

Sphinx is hiring a Founding Account Executive to own the full sales cycle from first touch to signed contract. Until now, sales has been founder-led; the company is now at the point where they need someone to build the pipeline, run the full cycle, and lay the foundation for a sales organization that scales. This is a builder seat, not a quota-carrying seat with a playbook handed to you.

What You'll Own

  • Own the full sales cycle from first touch to signed contract: prospecting, discovery, demos, negotiation, and close

  • Bring in new banks, fintechs, and MSBs across the US, Canada, Europe, and LatAm

  • Design the sales playbook, comp structures, and processes that let the team scale

  • Build Sphinx's sales organization alongside the CEO, including hiring the first AEs behind you

  • Partner with Dean and the GTM team to generate, qualify, and refine leads into a predictable pipeline

  • Shape pricing, packaging, territory planning, and competitive positioning

Must-Have

  1. 3-5+ years of enterprise sales experience closing contracts in the $100K to $1M+ range

  2. Prior sales experience in banks, large fintechs, or financial services institutions

  3. Full-cycle ownership: prospecting, discovery, demos, negotiation, and close

  4. Comfort with multi-stakeholder buying committees, procurement, and legal cycles

  5. Hunter mentality: builds pipeline, cold-calls confidently, creates opportunities

  6. Builder mindset, excited to write the playbook rather than execute against one

  7. Willing to relocate to San Francisco or already based there

Nice-to-Have

  • Existing network at banks, compliance consultancies, or large fintechs

  • Prior work at AML RightSource, Guidehouse, Protiviti, or comparable compliance consultancies

  • Prior sales at compliance tech, KYC/AML/KYB platforms, or financial crime infrastructure

  • Experience building a sales playbook from scratch at a Series A or B startup

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base: $150,000 - $200,000

  • OTE: $300,000 (50/50 base/variable at the $150K base point, sliding to ~65/35 at the $200K base point)

Interview Process

  • Screening call (fit & motivation)

  • Interview #1, in the office if possible.

  • Case study in the office.
